name: separator
title: Separator
description: A thin rule between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, in a border role at border.width.1.

manifest.name: separator
manifest.title: Separator
manifest.description: A thin rule between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, in a border role at border.width.1.
manifest.usage: Use Separator between sections of a panel, between groups of controls in a Toolbar or StatusBar (orientation="vertical"), or between the facts of a summary line. It is announced as a separator; for pure decoration use a border on the container instead. Between resizable panes use Resizable's handle, not a Separator.

props.name: variant
props.description: The border role: default between sections, muted inside a dense list, strong between panes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Sets aria-orientation and data-orientation; a vertical rule stretches to its row's height.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element with the separator's props.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The rule, role="separator"; data-slot="separator", data-variant, data-orientation.

states.name: vertical
states.description: A rule of border.width.1 that stretches to the row's height.

accessibility: Renders a <div role="separator"> with aria-orientation; screen readers announce the boundary between groups.
Not focusable and not interactive (a movable pane divider is Resizable's handle).
Thickness is border.width.1 and colour a border role, so it never carries information on its own.
